tool_description: Recall one Episodic Memory through either an exact identifier or a natural-language description. Use the same tool for both stages of intelligent recall.
When an exact Recall Key or exact Record ID is known, supply exactly one of them. GHOST then performs a deterministic exact fetch without vector search.

When no exact identifier is known, formulate query_description from the user's request. If the user mentions a relevant date or date interval, infer and normalize it into date_from and/or date_to as ISO values. GHOST returns up to ten compact Episode Description candidates with workflow_state selection_required.

When workflow_state is selection_required, compare the candidate descriptions with the user's request, select the best matching Record ID, and call ghost_memory_recall again with that exact record_id. When workflow_state is complete, do not call the tool again for this request.
The default result_mode is episode and returns the complete stored user and assistant pair. Use result_mode description only when the user explicitly asks for only the Episode Description.
server_instruction: For ghost_memory_recall, use exact recall whenever the user supplies a Recall Key or Record ID. Otherwise create query_description. When the user's request contains a relevant date or interval, infer its concrete ISO value and pass it as date_from, date_to, or both; otherwise omit both date fields.

A result with workflow_state selection_required is not the final episode: inspect the returned candidates, choose the best matching Record ID, and call ghost_memory_recall again with that exact ID and the same requested result_mode. A result with workflow_state complete is final and must not trigger another recall call.
Use result_mode episode by default. Use result_mode description only when the user explicitly requests only the stored Episode Description.

field_descriptions.recall_key: An exact stored Recall Key. Supply it only when the user knows or explicitly provides the key.
field_descriptions.record_id: An exact stored Record ID. Use it for deterministic direct recall or for the second call after selecting a semantic candidate.
field_descriptions.query_description: The semantic description of the sought memory formulated from the user's request. Use it only when no exact Recall Key or Record ID is known.
field_descriptions.date_from: Optional inclusive UTC lower bound for intelligent recall, expressed as an ISO date or ISO datetime.
field_descriptions.date_to: Optional inclusive UTC upper bound for intelligent recall, expressed as an ISO date or ISO datetime.
field_descriptions.result_mode: Select episode for the complete stored user and assistant pair, or description when the user explicitly wants only the Episode Description.
